scope: Bounded simulator screening of alternate GTA renderer. Not a controlled renderer benchmark, headset test, or stereo qualification.
decision: Retain SantosVision as the Vision Pro integration base. Alternate is not a demonstrated overall upgrade; its Metal upload/buffer reuse remains a useful implementation reference.
limitations: Different spawn locations: alternate Sandy Shores, baseline Michael mansion.
iOS27 versus visionOS27 simulator shells on a shared Mac, not physical hardware.
Same960x540 and60fps cap with Low/performance configuration intent; alternate12explicit quality options matched, but reading the copied XML from the assumed guest settings path was not instrumented.
Alternate wasm2c compiler policy and2-worker default differ from Wasmtime and host core count.
Audio silent in both: alternate simulator output mixer0; baseline game master0.
No immersive compositor in either measured screen; no4K/high-settings or matched-stereo result.
Mac had32GiB RAM and16.2GiB swap in use when sampled; this does not by itself prove active paging during every measured window.

baseline.name: Existing qualified SantosVision build
baseline.note: Installed pre-correctness executable. Current prototype source checkpoint e74b9d2 was not built or benchmarked here.
